adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Post.cook_methods` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and passes `contents` from feeds (`Jobs::PollFeed` uses `SimpleRSS.parse` and `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` but does not sanitize/strip tags). The embed view then renders `raw post.cooked` (and for raw_html, `cooked == raw` per the new cook path), so hostile feed HTML (including `<script>`) could be stored and executed as XSS on the forum origin.
